question: How should the measuring thread be laid out during altar construction?
premises: A thread must be laid out as part of the procedure.
The thread should run from south to north.
This should be done in proper order by that very means.
inference: By that very means one should lay out the thread running south to north in proper order.
plain_english: By that very means one should lay out the thread running from south to north, in proper order.
